title: Rational scalar comparison intertwines paths
statement: For an IntegralFibrePathTransport and E contained in L, the common-field rational scalar comparison intertwines scalar extensions of the rational paths. Specializing the common field to L and removing identity scalar extension proves the exact rational scalar path square of [new-e5-fibre-path-transport-data]. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [new-e5-integral-fibre-path-construction], [new-e5-rational-fibre-path-construction], [new-e5-rational-fibre-scalar-comparison].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: The integral scalar unit intertwines the integral paths by the integral scalar square and naturality of the scalar adjunction unit.

Use scalar-extension hom extensionality and tensor induction. On a nested pure tensor use the rational path evaluation formula and the rational comparison tensor formula. Both routes agree by the integral scalar unit square. Naturality of identity scalar extension gives the specialized rational scalar square.

theorem rationalFibreScalarIso_path [Algebra E.val L.val]
    (ha : algebraMap E.val L.val = (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom)
    (F : LisseRationalSheaf l E.val Y) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E.val L.val)).map
        (((rationalFibrePathFamily l E.val Y (i.linear E)).map y z t).hom.app F) ≫
      (rationalFibreScalarIso l Y z E.val L.val (IntermediateField.inclusion h) ha).hom.app F =
    (rationalFibreScalarIso l Y y E.val L.val (IntermediateField.inclusion h) ha).hom.app F ≫
      (((rationalFibrePathFamily l L.val Y (i.linear L)).map y z t).hom.app
        ((lisseRationalScalarExtension l E.val Y L.val
          (IntermediateField.inclusion h)).obj F))
